newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot Friday cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot Friday cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry.
Sales reported on 300 slaughter steers and 200 heifers following weekly movement of 74,600 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Few pens Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs 69.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few pens Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1100 lbs 69.00.
